_purpose: SD-36 Epic F1 re-check round 3, finding 1 (ORCHESTRATOR RULING). structural_diff.py's field-delta contract allows only `granted_by`/`grants` to grow; every other field delta gates the run. The `current_class` closure-tracker fix (closure.rs, commit 71c729e408, `converter resolves child ability categories through their parent`) correctly re-attributes several `SUBCLASSLEVEL` rows in a class's own chassis block that a pre-fix closure build misattributed off the class -- this grows ONLY `provenance.closure_rows` (no other field) on the class chassis's own principal rule and its `#bonusN` feat-pick-count sub-rules, for exactly the classes below. This is an enumerated, counted, explained EXPECTED delta class, not a blanket allowance: a `provenance` delta on any record NOT in `records`, or any delta to any OTHER field on any record, still fails the gate.
_command: cargo run --locked -j 8 -p codex-ingest --bin sheet_rule_convert -- --dump <scratch dir> && python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'docs/release/SD-36-consolidation/artifacts/epic-f/scripts'); import structural_diff as sd; base=sd.load_tree('data/sheet_rules'); fresh=sd.load_tree('<scratch dir>'); br=sd.rules_by_id(base['rule_files']); fr=sd.rules_by_id(fresh['rule_files']); print([rid for rid in sorted(set(br)&set(fr)) if sd.diff_rule(br[rid], fr[rid]) == ['provenance']])"
